sidebar.guest_prompt: Sign in to create playlists, save your favorite songs, and more.

settings.title: Settings
settings.romanization_desc: Show romanized lyrics for non-Latin scripts (Japanese, Korean, etc.)
settings.public_profile_desc: Allow anyone to see your profile and public playlists
settings.show_now_playing_desc: Let followers see what you're currently listening to
settings.show_recently_played_desc: Display your recent listening activity on your profile
settings.change_password_desc: We'll send a secure link to your email to set or update your password. If you signed up with Google, this lets you also log in with email and password.
settings.password_email_sent_desc: Check your inbox and click the link to set your new password.
settings.set_password_desc: Create a password for your account so you can also log in manually.
settings.password_too_short: Password must be at least 6 characters

profile.private_desc: This profile has been set to private by its owner. You cannot see their playlists and listening activity.

player.play_to_see_lyrics: Play a song to see lyrics

feature_disabled.title: Feature Currently Disabled
feature_disabled.desc: Sorry, this feature is under maintenance or temporarily disabled by the system.

identify.title: Identify Song
identify.login_desc: Sign in to identify songs and sync them to your library.

radio.title: Live Radio
radio.subtitle: Live radio stations from Indonesia and around the world
radio.no_stations_found: No stations found for your search
radio.no_stations_available: No stations available in this category

recap.title: Your Music Recap
recap.no_data: Listen to more songs to unlock your recap!

support.title: Keep the Music Playing.
support.subtitle: Support the Developer
support.description: AcadMusic is built with love and maintained independently. By tipping via Kreate, you help keep the servers running, ensure the app remains ad-free, and fuel the development of awesome new features!
support.disclaimer: *Your donation will trigger a live alert for everyone listening right now!

home.artist_stations_desc: Official YouTube live streams from artists you follow
home.no_recent_activity_friends: No recent activity from people you follow.
home.no_mood_songs: No songs available for this mood.
home.get_full_experience_desc: Sign in to save songs, create playlists, and listen to full tracks.
home.server_error_desc: Failed to connect to the backend. The server might be offline or unreachable.

library.made_for_you_desc: Open personal mixes built from your history, likes, mood, and Discover Weekly.
library.made_for_you_full_desc: A collection of personal mixes built from your listening history, liked songs, mood, and Discover Weekly.
library.discover_active: Discover Weekly is active and ready to play
library.discover_empty: No Discover Weekly yet? Don't worry, check back next week.
library.login_liked_title: Log in to view liked songs
library.login_liked_desc: After logging in, songs you like will automatically appear here.
library.no_liked_songs_desc: Tap the heart icon from the player or search results to save songs here.
library.songs_desc: All songs collected from your likes, recent plays, and playlists.
library.login_songs_title: Log in to view Library Songs
library.login_songs_desc: After logging in, all songs you like, play, or save will appear here.
library.recent_desc: A mix of the latest albums and playlists in your library.
library.login_recent_title: Log in to view recent activity
library.login_recent_desc: Your playlist and album activities will appear here.
library.login_mixes_title: Log in to view personal mixes
library.login_mixes_desc: Once logged in, this page will automatically curate mixes based on your listening history and favorite songs.
library.no_followed_artists_desc: Follow your favorite artists to unlock automatic live music stations right on your Home screen!
library.playlist_empty_desc: Find and add songs from the search page or your library.
library.artists_desc: Artists you follow and artists that appear most frequently in your library.

library.login_artists_desc: Your favorite artists list will automatically build from the songs you save and play.
library.artist_not_found_desc: Try searching for another artist name.
library.no_artists_yet_desc: Start listening to or saving songs to build your artist list.
library.albums_desc: Albums formed from tracks you have played, saved, and added to playlists.
library.login_albums_title: Log in to view album library
library.login_albums_desc: Once logged in, albums will automatically collect from your listening activity.
library.album_not_found_desc: Try searching for another album title or artist name.
library.no_albums_yet_desc: Start listening to and saving songs to fill your album collection.
library.liked_playlists_desc: Public playlists you have saved to your library
